description: Validation harness for WebSocket real-time dashboard updates. Automated test suite with 5 test cases covering connection, events, metrics, reconnection, and multi-client scenarios.

testCases.name: connection-establishment
testCases.description: Verify WebSocket connection establishment and authentication

testCases.name: execution-events
testCases.description: Verify all execution events are broadcast in correct order

testCases.name: metrics-updates
testCases.description: Verify metrics updates contain all required fields

testCases.name: auto-reconnect
testCases.description: Verify WebSocket auto-reconnects after connection drop

testCases.name: multi-client
testCases.description: Verify events broadcast to all connected clients

programmatic.execute: const result = await runValidation({ testCase: 'connection-establishment', apiUrl: 'ws://localhost:8080/ws' })

requirement1.requirement: Dashboard establishes WebSocket connection to API

requirement2.requirement: API broadcasts activity state changes to connected clients

requirement3.requirement: Dashboard updates UI in real-time showing task progress, status, and metrics

requirement4.requirement: Connection resilience with automatic reconnection on disconnect

requirement5.requirement: No polling required - all updates pushed via WebSocket events

expectedBehavior.passConditions: All test assertions pass, no errors
expectedBehavior.failConditions: Any assertion fails or timeout occurs

integrationPoints.dashboard: Not directly tested (harness tests API only)
integrationPoints.k8s: Can be run in K8s Job for continuous validation

futureEnhancements: Add UI interaction tests with Playwright
Add network disruption simulation (packet loss, latency)
Add event replay tests (ensure no duplicates on reconnect)
